title: Cooling the Concrete Jungle: An AI-Enabled Urban Heat Island Mitigation Advisor for Sustainable Development.
summary: Christ University is developing an urban heat advisor to identify vulnerable areas and support targeted cooling and energy decisions.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The MVP uses proposed modeling and vulnerability assessment to inform heat mitigation. The intended beneficiaries include people exposed to extreme heat and city planners. Wider climate-risk integration is planned. No implemented cooling action, measured temperature change, or health outcome is reported.
purpose: Guide equitable urban heat mitigation and climate-resilience planning.
system: Cooling the Concrete Jungle: An AI-Enabled Urban Heat Island Mitigation Advisor for Sustainable Development.

ratings.reason: The urban heat advisor is in MVP development; no implemented cooling decision or energy saving is shown.
No heat-related illness or death is shown to have been prevented.
Heat resilience and equitable cooling are planned benefits.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 18: Cooling the Concrete Jungle: An AI-Enabled Urban Heat Island Mitigation Advisor for Sustainable Development.

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: An urban heat advisor proposes targeted cooling measures
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
